name: Sons of the Forest
description: Co-op survival horror sequel to The Forest. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); the server binary is a Windows executable.
notes: The install always fetches the Windows depot (platformOverride) because the published server binary is SonsOfTheForestDS.exe. On Linux hosts it needs Wine/Proton: set the start command override to e.g. wine SonsOfTheForestDS.exe -userdatapath ./userdata. Configuration (server name, password, ports, save slots) lives in userdata/dedicatedserver.cfg after the first run; saves are kept inside ./userdata so panel backups include them.
